parameters.name: ClientSecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the security groups for the endpoint that is used to access the bastion host over a private network.

parameters.name: EnablePortalPrivateAccess
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the O\&M portal of the bastion host to be accessed over a private network.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host to start.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the security groups to which the bastion host is bound.

parameters.name: SlaveVswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary vSwitch to which the bastion host is bound.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the bastion host is bound.
